article.summary_es: Esta iglesia aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos en el Bronx. Reparte alimentos lunes, miércoles y jueves.
article.summary_en: This church appears on the Food Help NYC map as a food pantry in the Bronx. It distributes food on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC.
Está en 495 Willis Ave, Bronx, NY 10455.
Atiende lunes de 11:30am a 2:30pm y miércoles y jueves de 11:30am a 2:30pm.
Puede llamar al (718) 842-4504 para preguntar antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry according to the Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 495 Willis Ave, Bronx, NY 10455.
It is open Mondays 11:30am-2:30pm and Wednesdays and Thursdays 11:30am-2:30pm.
You can call (718) 842-4504 to ask before going.
